in_marathi.name: Mayurak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mayurak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mayurak is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'mayura' meaning peacock and 'aksha' meaning son. In Hindu mythology, the peacock is considered sacred and is the vehicle of Goddess Saraswati.
